$comment: Where pnpm figma:links points design <-> code links (README section, Figma dev resources, component documentation links). Component Figma nodes come from each component's @figma JSDoc tag, never from here. storybookUrl: the deployed Storybook root (for example the Chromatic library URL); while null, story links point at the story file on GitHub.
$comment_figmaFiles: ADR-026. libraryFileKey is the published library 'HDS Tokens & Components' and is READ-ONLY to agents — every consumer resolves from it, so an agent write there propagates irreversibly. Agent writes go to stagingFileKey, a duplicate Adrian promotes by hand (Pro has no branching, so there is no automatic merge). While stagingFileKey is null an agent has no legal write target; that is the intended failure mode, not a reason to fall back to the library.
